name: Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child
benefit:
- Under the scheme, a scholarship of ₹5,000/- per year is given to single girl child students.

**Note:** The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student&#39;s bank account.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a girl student.
   1. The applicant should be the only girl child of her parents.
   1. The girl student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The girl student should have scored 60% or more marks in the 10th class examination under the curriculum of the Madhya Pradesh Secondary Education Board.
   1. The girl should be studying in Class 11 or 12 at a recognized private school.
   1. The school tuition fees should be less than ₹1,500/- per month.
   1. The girl student should have passed the previous class.

**Note 1:** If the parents are government employees, a certificate from the head of the office confirming the applicant is the only child or an attested copy of the family list in the ration card, is required.
**Note 2:** If the parents are not government employees, an affidavit from a notary confirming the applicant is the only child, or an attested copy of the ration card, is required.
